'''2019 Online Championship Series Playoffs''' was the Players Committee OCS playoff on GEMP. [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] defeated [[Justin Branch]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-online-championship-series-registration-opens/. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022095952/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2022-online-championship-series-registration-opens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' October–December 2019
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/major-event-winners/ forum]
